messages.author: c2415bf310ec31ff
messages.subject: Strange plots
parts:
Hi all, 
I am a masters student who is using this package for the first time and am having some issues. When trying to plot my data with 'plot' it produces a strange graph like this

however when I plot the data with ggplot it produces a normal looking graph

does anyone know why this could be happening? It probably means that something is wrong with the layout of my data but I'm not sure what.
If it helps, the data is not from MoveBank

Thanks,
Charlie

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Strange plots
parts:
Hi Charlie,

You can set error=FALSE to turn the error circles off. You can also set error=2 to switch from error circles to error disks and then adjust transparency.error.

Best,
Chris

Best,
Chris
